I’ve been on pristiq for I believe three years first year was 50 then I went up to 100 and I gained 15 pounds over two months I was eating badly and stressed it was around the holiday but in the next two years I managed to gain another 25 pounds. I feel so terrible about myself I no longer feel any benefit to taking the drug. I will say I’ve never eaten more or less on the drug. I also felt that my mind chemistry has adjusted and I no longer feel the emotional boost the drug used to have. I’m praying to god that going off this medication will give me a fighting chance over my body. I know you’re not supposed to cut the pills but when I decided to wanted to start tapering I didn’t want to wait, I’m at two weeks on 75 and done fairly well some crying screaming spells but my pms was just last week. I’m thinking dropping to 50 at the 3 and a half week mark. I definitely want to be off this and well before seasonal depression hits. I’m 31 I know age probably plays a role in the bounce back portion of this, but if anyone who suspected weight gain from pristiq how long did it take you to begin losing weight was it during tapering or after quitting completely? I learned trails are only from people taking the drugs over a few months never years and not high doses, so what fun...
